title: 阿尔伯塔留加公投过关 卡尼赢得关键一役
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The western province of Alberta has kept Canada on edge over the last year.
segments.zh: 过去一年，西部省份阿尔伯塔让加拿大持续紧张。

segments.en: Could the oil-rich region decide to break away from the country?
segments.zh: 这个石油资源丰富的地区会决定脱离加拿大吗？

segments.en: Well, last night voters delivered a decisive answer.
segments.zh: 昨晚，选民给出了明确答案。

segments.en: No. While battles were still being counted this morning, a clear majority had voted in favor of remaining in Canada, giving Prime Minister Mark Carney the result he had hoped for.
segments.zh: 不。今早计票仍在进行时，明显多数已投票支持留在加拿大，给了总理卡尼他期望的结果。

segments.en: He has worked over the past year to reverse or water down many of his predecessor Justin Trudeau's policies.
segments.zh: 过去一年，他努力逆转或淡化前任贾斯汀·特鲁多的多项政策。

segments.en: Albertans felt the rest of the country was attacking their crown jewel, the energy industry, by implementing tough environmental regulations.
segments.zh: 阿尔伯塔人觉得国内其他地区通过实施严格环保法规，攻击了他们的支柱产业——能源业。

segments.en: Carney has tried to turn the page from that era. In a series of agreements over the last year and a half with Alberta Premier Daniel Smith, Carney has made making Canada an energy superpower a core part of his government agenda,
segments.zh: 卡尼试图翻开新的一页。过去一年半，他与阿尔伯塔省长丹尼尔·史密斯达成一系列协议，将让加拿大成为能源超级大国作为政府议程核心。

segments.en: so much so that he has promised to fast track approvals for a new million barrel a day pipeline to the BC coast.
segments.zh: 以至于他承诺快速审批一条通往BC省海岸、日输百万桶的新管道。

segments.en: In speeches last week in Calgary and Edmonton, he acknowledged the pain those in the province had felt over Trudeau's policies.
segments.zh: 上周在卡尔加里和埃德蒙顿的演讲中，他承认该省民众因特鲁多政策而感受到的痛苦。

segments.en: He said Alberta has helped shape Canada's history and that it will continue to be part of building a better nation moving forward.
segments.zh: 他说阿尔伯塔帮助塑造了加拿大的历史，未来将继续参与建设更美好的国家。

segments.en: Premier Smith called the vote in May and she also came out for the Federalist side, saying that for the first time in a long time, Alberta and Canada were working together.
segments.zh: 史密斯省长在五月发起投票，她也公开支持联邦派，称阿尔伯塔与加拿大许久以来首次携手合作。

segments.en: But even as Carney has one cloud hanging over his government pass, more on the horizon.
segments.zh: 但即便卡尼政府刚渡过一道难关，更多挑战仍在前方。

segments.en: Last night, voters also weighed in on nine additional questions posed by Smith.
segments.zh: 昨晚，选民还就史密斯提出的九个附加问题表达了意见。

segments.en: The results of those could set up possible battles between her government and Carney's on immigration policy and constitutional reforms.
segments.zh: 这些结果可能引发她的政府与卡尼政府在移民政策和宪法改革上的潜在交锋。

segments.en: There also remains a lot of healing to do in the province.
segments.zh: 该省仍有许多关系需要修复。
